metadata.title: Bangladesh Agricultural Datasets
metadata.attribution: Rahman, M. B.; Chakma, J. D. (2021). Bangladesh Agricultural Datasets, Version 5. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/8pvfs5wyzf.5. CC BY 4.0.
metadata.evidenceType: secondary research phenology derived from BBS Yearbook 2020 and a crop-seasons article
metadata.geographicLevel: national only; no district or upazila records
metadata.periodGranularity: source month labels only; no day-level dates
metadata.exclusionReason: Temperature and humidity columns are internally inconsistent (maximum RH is below minimum RH); normalized/cluster features are derived outputs, not raw agronomic observations.
qualityLimitations: Source is a secondary compilation from BBS 2020 and a crop-seasons article; it is not a current calendar or official recommendation.
Some crop labels are source spellings or cultivar/product variants and are retained verbatim.
Month periods are not assigned an inferred year or exact dates; unparsed source periods remain null.
Records with exact crop, season, and period duplicates of AgriClimateBD v2 are omitted to avoid duplicate phenology entries.
